headline: As of 2026-10-13: 3,510,556 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+23.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,510,556 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+23.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (531,373), Florida (529,713), Michigan (440,677).
